newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanghai Petchem to buy acrylic plant.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Petchem to buy acrylic plant.

text.p: China's Shanghai Petrochemical Co Ltd said it has signed a letter of intent to buy a controlling interest in the Zhejiang Acrylic Fibre Plant.

The company said in a statement late on Monday it signed the initial agreement on June 22 with Zhejiang Province Economic Construction and Investment Co and Ningbo City Economic Construction and Investment Co.
Approval from the central authorities was still needed to seal the deal, it said.
Zhejiang Acrylic is a joint venture of Zhejiang province and Ningbo city and has a yearly production capacity of 30,000 tonnes of acrylic fibre and 10,000 tonnes of acrylic top.
The statement did not say what Shanghai Petrochemical's intended stake would be.
